// PROBE — must turn tests/unit/one-locale-per-request.test.tsx red:
// a layout that resolves the language on the server but mounts the dictionary
// without seeding the client provider, so the client half starts at its own default.
export default async function Layout({ children }) {
    const { dbUser } = await getAuthenticatedUser()
    const language = resolveUserLanguage(dbUser.preferredLanguage)
    const t = getTranslations(language)
    return <TranslationsProvider><AppShell t={t}>{children}</AppShell></TranslationsProvider>
}
